name: Ruins of Uldum
summary: Tucked into the jagged cliffs of the Valley of the Watchers in southern Tanaris, the Ruins of Uldum consist of an ancient stone hall guarding a sealed Titan facility. Massive stone doors protect its secrets from grave robbers and curious explorers alike.

sections.title: The Antechamber of the Titans
sections.body: Carved deep into the bedrock of southern Tanaris, the Ruins of Uldum appear to be an antechamber or grand threshold to a far larger, sealed subterranean complex. Its colossal stone gates stand shut against the outside world, and no mechanism or key known to modern scholars has managed to open them.

sections.title: Secrets of the Biosphere
sections.body: According to ancient records and celestial watchers, Uldum was established by the Titans alongside facilities like Uldaman and Ulduar as a research site dedicated to modifying and monitoring the biosphere of Azeroth. When the Great Sundering tore the world apart ten thousand years ago, the earthen felt the agony of the world and retreated into these subterranean vaults to hibernate. Full access beyond the ruins' sealed inner threshold requires the lost Plates of Uldum, leaving the full extent of the facility locked away from modern surface-dwellers.

faq.q: What is inside the Ruins of Uldum?
faq.answer: No one knows for certain. The ruins are an ancient titan hall sealed behind massive stone gates, and the complex beyond them remains closed to modern explorers.

faq.q: Can players enter the main facility behind the door?
aliases: can you open the door to uldum
faq.answer: No. The gates remain sealed. The Stone Watcher of Norgannon says entry into the Uldum compound is allowed only to those who carry the lost Plates of Uldum, and no one has yet found them.

Titan constructs such as the Stone Watcher of Norgannon describe Uldum as a research complex intended to study, sustain, and enhance Azeroth's biosphere, similar in origin to sites like Uldaman and Ulduar.

angles.text: For dwarves tracing their lineage back to the earthen, Uldum represents one of the original titan crèches where their ancestors first rested following the Sundering.
The stonework and machinery of Uldum showcase titan craftsmanship that has endured thousands of years of tectonic pressure and desert decay without faltering.
